bubbles.title: Pick --to commands
bubbles.hint: Decided: --to <track> on add, insert, hint only. State-changing commands (done, fill, fog, move, remove, rename, type) stay on the current track

bubbles.title: Implement --to
bubbles.hint: Parse --to <track> in lib/cli/args.ts; the chosen bubble commands load/save that track instead of the current one, current stays unchanged. Target must exist and not be closed. Add to HELP

bubbles.title: Move --to
bubbles.hint: move N | N:M --to <track>: move bubbles (with hint, type, state) out of the current track into <track>, appended at the end. Revises the decision in #1: move now takes --to too. Target must exist, not be closed, not be the current track. Moved bubbles get new ids from the target's nextId. Bubbles with fork/sides links: refuse for now (no re-linking). Decide when reached: allow done bubbles?, optional 'at M' position in target. Tests in #4. First real use: the src-changes split (see its handoff).

bubbles.title: Tests
bubbles.hint: test/cli.test.js: --to writes into target, current track untouched, refuses closed/missing target and commands that don't take --to
